verification: All 17 Identity Cards and questions matched the supplied manuscript after typography normalization. Linked website prose includes editorial adaptations.

blueprints.title: Debt-Free
blueprints.identity: I am someone who handles debt deliberately.
blueprints.question: Would someone handling debt deliberately finance this?

blueprints.title: Financial Organization
blueprints.identity: I am someone who processes, decides and clears.
blueprints.question: Would someone who processes, decides and clears let this sit?

blueprints.title: Wealth Building
blueprints.identity: I am someone who handles money deliberately and builds stability where I can.
blueprints.question: Would a wealth builder make this decision?

blueprints.title: Fitness
blueprints.identity: I am someone who takes care of my body.
blueprints.question: What would someone who takes care of their body do in this moment?

blueprints.title: Rested
blueprints.identity: I am someone who recovers on purpose.
blueprints.question: Would someone who recovers on purpose still be awake right now?

blueprints.title: The Body I Have Today
blueprints.identity: I am someone who trains with the body I have today.
blueprints.question: What does my body need today, and did I give it that?

blueprints.title: Parenting
blueprints.identity: I am a parent who practices presence and repairs when I get it wrong.
blueprints.question: What am I teaching by how I handle this?

blueprints.title: Partnership
blueprints.identity: I am the partner I would want to have.
blueprints.question: Did I show up today?

blueprints.title: Calm
blueprints.identity: I am someone who stays steady under pressure. I regulate before I respond.
blueprints.question: Would someone who stays steady escalate this?

blueprints.title: Confidence
blueprints.identity: I am someone who enters the room as an equal and contributes. I speak without waiting to be invited.
blueprints.question: Am I shrinking or contributing?

blueprints.title: Leadership
blueprints.identity: I am a leader who turns ambiguity into clarity.
blueprints.question: Did I create clarity or confusion?

blueprints.title: Build Without Permission
blueprints.identity: I am someone who builds at full size.
blueprints.question: Would I wait for someone else’s yes right now?

blueprints.title: Creation
blueprints.identity: I am a creator who ships.
blueprints.question: Did I ship this week?

blueprints.title: The Third Act
blueprints.identity: I am a builder in my third act.
blueprints.question: What did I build or transfer today?

blueprints.title: The Side-Build
blueprints.identity: I am a founder with a day job.
blueprints.question: Did the build touch the market this week?

blueprints.title: Operator To Owner
blueprints.identity: I am an owner, not the operator.
blueprints.question: Is this task mine, or am I hiding in it?

blueprints.title: Business Owner
blueprints.identity: I am answerable for what this business produces.
blueprints.question: Am I running it, or hiding in it?
